replacement.name: Hotel Regency
replacement.tagline: Mizoram's first 3-star hotel, perched on Mac Donald Hill above Zarkawt with hill-side rooms, multi-cuisine restaurant and the city's most reliable hot water — dry-state, so the bar is a juice bar.
replacement.address: B-49, Mac Donald Hill, Zarkawt, Aizawl, Mizoram 796007

replacement.name: Hotel Floria
replacement.tagline: 33 rooms one block off Bara Bazaar in Dawrpui — the closest mid-range hotel to the markets, churches and taxi stand, with panoramic hill views from the upper floors and a sober multi-cuisine restaurant (no alcohol, like all of Aizawl).

replacement.name: David's Hotel Clover
replacement.tagline: Long-running budget hotel in Chanmari with four room categories, in-house restaurant and walking access to Mizoram State Museum — the dependable mid-tier option when Regency and Floria are full.

replacement.name: Aizawl Guest House
replacement.tagline: Mary's family-run guest house perched on Laipuitlang ridge — the highest point in Aizawl, with three bedrooms, a serviced apartment and 270-degree views over the city; cash-only and an honest taste of Mizo hospitality and home cooking.

replacement.name: Hotel Hranga Plaza
replacement.tagline: Recently built mid-range hotel in Vengthlang — the most modern option in Champhai's small inventory, with KFC and Crush N Bite within walking distance for the rare branded meal in this border hill town.

replacement.name: Hotel Chawngthu
replacement.tagline: Family-run budget hotel in Vengthlang from ₹600/night — the working traveller's pick when the Tourist Lodge is full, with simple Mizo home cooking and the usual Sunday closures across town.

replacement.name: Champhai Tourist Lodge
replacement.tagline: State-run lodge in Zion Veng managed by the Art and Culture Department — single rooms, double rooms and a decorated cottage on the ridge, the default fallback for the eastern border circuit (book through tourism.mizoram.gov.in).
replacement.address: Champhai Main Road, Zion Veng, Champhai, Mizoram 796321

replacement.name: Hotel Elite
replacement.tagline: Hill-top hotel on the west end of Lunglei in Venglai, near the Circuit House — quiet, balcony views from every room, and the only property in Mizoram's second city with a Travellers' Choice award.
replacement.address: Venglai, near Circuit House, Lunglei, Mizoram 796701

replacement.name: Lunglei Tourist Lodge (MZTDC)
replacement.tagline: Mizoram Tourism Department lodge in Zotlang — government rates, dependable, the standard fallback for the southern hub when Hotel Elite books out (mandatory online booking via tourism.mizoram.gov.in).

replacement.name: The Hotel Alabasta
replacement.tagline: Small budget hotel in Lunglei town centre — well-kept rooms, walking distance to the bazaar and bus stand, the urban-character contrast to Hotel Elite's quiet hilltop.

replacement.name: Sangau Tourist Lodge
replacement.tagline: The default Phawngpui basecamp — Mizoram Tourism's village lodge in Sangau, ~35 km from the National Park gate; basic rooms, hot meals on order, and the trailhead for 4WD onward to Far Pak Forest Rest House (Nov-Apr open season).

replacement.name: Far Pak Forest Rest House
replacement.tagline: Inside Phawngpui Blue Mountain National Park — Forest Department rest house at Far Pak, 12 km of 4WD beyond Sangau; bunks for 10-15, no power, carry your own supplies. The closest you can sleep to the 2,157 m summit.
replacement.address: Far Pak, Phawngpui (Blue Mountain) National Park, Lawngtlai District, Mizoram
